name: Uday Pratap Singh Parihar
headline: Full Stack Web Developer · React / Next.js / TypeScript · Node.js / Python · AI-integrated web & mobile products
summary: Full stack developer with 3+ years shipping commercial web and mobile applications end to end. Currently **founding engineer at Akin**, where I built and shipped a React Native consumer app to the **App Store and Play Store** on an Express/PostgreSQL backend. Previously two years as founding engineer on a live B2B logistics platform, owning architecture, backend, dashboards and integrations. Comfortable with real-time services, cloud deployment, LLM-powered features, and reverse-engineering undocumented APIs when no SDK exists.

experience.title: Founding Engineer
bullets: Built and shipped a **React Native (Expo)** community app to the **App Store and Play Store** — event discovery and booking, digital tickets, location-based member discovery with maps, and push notifications.
Owned the **Express + PostgreSQL** backend across an **18-table** schema (Drizzle ORM) plus admin dashboards, deployed as **Dockerized** services behind Traefik with automated migrations.
Shipped **4 sign-in methods** (email/SMS OTP, Apple, Google) and cleared **full Apple and Google store review**, with EAS builds and **over-the-air updates**.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Shipped production features and fixes across **web and mobile** (Next.js + React Native), improving chatbot UX and reliability.
Built **agentic LLM workflows** in Dify orchestrating model calls with **BigQuery**-backed trade-data retrieval.
Delivered **rich responses** (text plus charts and graphs) by wiring workflows into the app's data and services layer.
